scoring_justification: The headline barriers are DFT results that cannot be recomputed from raw artifacts without re‑running the full NEB calculations in the verifier; scored by comparing the agent’s reported barriers to the paper‑reported gold values with tolerances and trend verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference barrier values from paper (Ni‑Cu‑OOH step₁ = 4.91 eV, Ni‑Cu‑Fe‑OOH step₁ = 1.08 eV, ratio ≈4.5, N₂ formation exothermic) and tolerances used to verify the agent’s CSV.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 1b and text; values are the DFT/NEB computed barriers reported by the authors.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted verbatim from the paper; tolerances chosen to accommodate expected toolchain spread (PBE+U, different pseudopotentials).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper’s original reported results; they are the same as those used to construct the reference solve.sh, guaranteeing positive control.

outputs.description: Computed energy barriers for the five elementary steps of the N+N mechanism on Ni-Cu-OOH and Ni-Cu-Fe-OOH surfaces. Checked against paper-reported barriers with tolerances, and verified that Step 1 is the rate-limiting step and Fe codoping reduces barrier by approximately 4.5-fold.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare individual barrier values to reference values and assess trends (rate-limiting step, exothermicity of N2 formation on codoped system). Charge difference analysis is omitted because it provides only qualitative isosurface maps without a numerical reference.

params.description: Step 1 must be the highest barrier for both Ni-Cu-OOH and Ni-Cu-Fe-OOH.

params.exothermic_condition: Ni-Cu-Fe-OOH step 5 barrier must be negative; Ni-Cu-OOH step 5 barrier must be positive.
